title: Simple Resignation Letter Template
description: Free professional resignation letter template you can copy, edit, and use for leaving a job professionally.
intro: This simple resignation letter template helps employees formally resign from a position while keeping communication professional and respectful.
whenToUse: Use this template when leaving a job and providing formal written notice.
template:
Dear [Manager Name],

I am writing to formally resign from my position at [Company Name], effective [Last Working Day].

Thank you for the opportunities and support during my time with the company.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
Dear Mr. Smith,

I am writing to formally resign from my position at ABC Corp, effective March 30, 2026.

Sincerely,
John Doe

faqs.question: Should a resignation letter be formal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Professional resignation letters help maintain positive relationships with employers.

faqs.question: Can I resign by email?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many employers accept resignation notices by email.

title: Two Weeks Notice Letter Template
description: Free two weeks notice letter template for professionally resigning from a job.
intro: This template helps employees formally communicate a resignation while providing a standard two weeks notice period.
whenToUse: Use this template when resigning from a job and giving advance notice.
template:
Dear [Manager Name],

Please accept this letter as formal notice of my resignation from [Company Name]. My final working day will be [Last Working Day].

Thank you for the opportunity.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
Dear Ms. Johnson,

Please accept this letter as formal notice of my resignation from Bright Solutions. My final working day will be April 14, 2026.

Sincerely,
Sarah Lee

faqs.question: What is a two weeks notice letter?
faqs.answer: A two weeks notice letter informs an employer that you plan to leave your role in two weeks.

faqs.question: Do all jobs require two weeks notice?
faqs.answer: Policies vary depending on the employer and employment agreement.

title: Cover Letter Template
description: Professional cover letter template for job applications.
intro: This cover letter template helps job applicants introduce themselves professionally and highlight qualifications.
whenToUse: Use when applying for jobs and submitting resumes.
template:

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Coordinator role at Bright Media.

Sincerely,
Jane Smith

faqs.question: Should every resume include a cover letter?
faqs.answer: Many employers prefer cover letters because they provide additional context about your experience.

faqs.question: How long should a cover letter be?
faqs.answer: Most cover letters should remain concise and fit on one page.

title: Recommendation Letter Template
description: Professional recommendation letter template for employees and students.
intro: This recommendation letter template helps employers, teachers, and mentors write strong references.
whenToUse: Use when writing references for jobs, schools, or applications.
template:

I highly recommend [Name] for [Position or Program].

example:

I highly recommend Sarah Lee for your graduate program.

faqs.question: What should recommendation letters include?
faqs.answer: Recommendation letters should include qualifications, strengths, and professional observations.

faqs.question: Who can write recommendation letters?
faqs.answer: Managers, teachers, mentors, and supervisors commonly write recommendation letters.

title: Two Weeks Notice Letter Template for Teachers
description: Free two weeks notice letter template for teachers resigning professionally from schools or academic institutions.
intro: This teacher resignation letter template helps educators formally provide two weeks notice while maintaining professionalism with school administration, coworkers, parents, and students.
whenToUse: Use this template when resigning from a teaching position and providing formal notice to your school or district.
template:
Dear [Principal or Administrator Name],

Please accept this letter as formal notice of my resignation from my teaching position at [School Name], effective two weeks from today.

I appreciate the opportunities and experiences I have gained while working with the students and staff.

I will do my best to assist with the transition process during my remaining time.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
Dear Principal Johnson,

Please accept this letter as formal notice of my resignation from my teaching position at Green Valley High School, effective two weeks from today.

I appreciate the support and opportunities provided during my time at the school.

Sincerely,
Sarah Williams
tips: Provide adequate notice whenever possible.
Maintain a respectful and appreciative tone.
Offer to assist with transition planning.
Keep a signed copy for your records.

faqs.question: Do teachers need to give two weeks notice?
faqs.answer: Policies vary by school district and employment contract.

faqs.question: Should teachers explain why they are resigning?
faqs.answer: A detailed explanation is optional unless required by the employer.

faqs.question: Can teachers resign mid-year?
faqs.answer: Yes, but contracts and district policies may affect the process.

title: Cover Letter Template for Software Developers
description: Free software developer cover letter template for tech job applications.
intro: This software developer cover letter template helps developers introduce themselves professionally and highlight technical skills, programming experience, and relevant projects when applying for technology roles.
whenToUse: Use this template when applying for software engineering, web development, or technical programming positions.
template:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the [Job Title] position at [Company Name]. With experience in [Programming Languages or Technologies], I have developed strong technical and problem-solving skills.

In my previous role at [Company], I contributed to projects involving [Key Achievements or Technologies]. I am confident my experience and passion for development would make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Front-End Developer position at TechNova. With experience in React, JavaScript, and TypeScript, I have built responsive web applications and improved user experiences.

In my previous role at BrightApps, I helped develop customer-facing dashboards used by over 20,000 users.

Sincerely,
Michael Chen
tips: Mention specific technologies and programming languages.
Highlight measurable achievements and projects.
Customize the letter for each company and role.
Keep the cover letter concise and professional.

faqs.question: Should software developers submit cover letters?
faqs.answer: Many employers still value customized cover letters for technical roles.

faqs.question: What should a developer cover letter include?
faqs.answer: It should include technical skills, relevant experience, and interest in the role.

faqs.question: Should projects be mentioned?
faqs.answer: Yes, mentioning relevant projects can strengthen your application.

title: Cover Letter Template for Marketing Roles
description: Marketing cover letter template for job applications.
intro: This marketing cover letter template helps professionals highlight campaign experience, branding skills, and measurable marketing results.
whenToUse: Use this template when applying for marketing, communications, branding, or advertising roles.
template:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the [Position Name] role at [Company Name]. With experience in [Marketing Channels or Campaign Types], I have helped deliver measurable results for brands and audiences.

In my previous role at [Company], I led [Key Achievement] and improved [Metric].

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist role at BrightWave Media. With experience in email marketing, paid social campaigns, and content strategy, I helped increase lead generation by 35%.

In my previous role at GrowthWorks, I led a campaign that drove a 20% increase in qualified inbound leads.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Olivia Nguyen
tips: Mention specific marketing channels and results.
Tailor the letter to the employer’s brand and goals.
Keep the tone professional and enthusiastic.
Keep the cover letter concise and easy to read.

faqs.question: Should marketing cover letters mention metrics?
faqs.answer: Yes, including metrics helps demonstrate concrete impact.

faqs.question: How long should a marketing cover letter be?
faqs.answer: Keep it to one page with a clear introduction and achievement summary.

faqs.question: Can I reuse this cover letter for multiple applications?
faqs.answer: Yes, but customize each version to the role and company.

title: Recommendation Letter Template for Employees
description: Employee recommendation letter template for professional references.
intro: This recommendation letter template helps managers and supervisors provide positive, professional references for employees.
whenToUse: Use this template when writing references for employees applying to new jobs, promotions, or professional programs.
template:
To Whom It May Concern,

I am pleased to recommend [Employee Name] for [Position or Opportunity]. [Employee Name] has been employed at [Company Name] as a [Job Title] since [Start Date] and consistently demonstrated [Key Strengths].

Their strengths include [Strength 1], [Strength 2], and [Strength 3]. I believe they would be a strong asset to your team.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Title]
example:
To Whom It May Concern,

I am pleased to recommend Michael Park for the Senior Operations Manager role. Michael has been employed at Summit Logistics as Operations Coordinator since 2021 and consistently demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and strong communication.

His strengths include process improvement, team collaboration, and attention to detail. I believe he would be a strong asset to your team.

Sincerely,
Karen Lee
Operations Director
tips: Highlight the employee’s strongest skills and achievements.
Keep the tone positive, honest, and concise.
Include specific examples when possible.
Sign and date the letter for credibility.

faqs.question: Who should write employee recommendation letters?
faqs.answer: Managers, supervisors, or mentors who know the employee’s work are the best writers.

faqs.question: What should be included in a recommendation letter?
faqs.answer: Include the employee’s role, strengths, accomplishments, and suitability for the opportunity.

faqs.question: Can recommendation letters be requested after leaving a job?
faqs.answer: Yes, former employers can still provide references if they agree.

title: Cover Letter Template for Teaching Positions

In my current role at [School], I implemented [Program or Achievement] that improved student engagement.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

In my current role at Maple Ridge Elementary, I implemented a reading program that increased student participation by 20%.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Cassie Rivera
tips: Mention teaching experience and subject expertise.
Highlight positive student outcomes and classroom achievements.
Tailor the letter to the school’s mission and culture.
Keep the letter concise and professional.

faqs.question: Should teaching cover letters mention student success?
faqs.answer: Yes, highlighting student outcomes strengthens your application.

faqs.question: Can a teacher use a generic cover letter?

faqs.question: What should a teacher include in a cover letter?
faqs.answer: Include experience, instructional strengths, and reasons you’re a good fit.
